generic_domain.justification: Deep Learning is a subset of Machine Learning and a type of Artificial Intelligence (AI). It focuses on algorithms that learn multiple levels of representation, with its main strength being the handling and analysis of non-linear decision boundaries in high-dimensional spaces. Unlike traditional rule-based AI or machine learning methods, deep learning uses end-to-end learning, enabling models to automatically extract high-level features from data instead of relying on manually crafted features. Deep Learning enables tasks such as image recognition, speech processing, and natural language understanding without explicitly programming the learning process or relying on hand-crafted feature extraction steps.
